source.title: Defanged
source.description:
Battle is all I know, <name>. During the third war, countless fell before my blade. When the war ended, I made my way as a prize fighter. That is when I came upon the arena of Gadgetzan.

My days there were glorious, but I soon tired of being champion. I came to Azshara in search of a greater challenge; a blue drake who roams south-east of here. Alas, the creature got the better of me. I escaped alive, but my blade was taken for its hoard.

If you recover my blade, I will return with you to Gadgetzan.
source.objective: Retrieve Kajind's blade from the blue drake roaming south-east of Forlorn Ridge in Azshara.
source.progress: I do not fault your hesitation, <race>. The drake is a fearsome foe.
source.completion: Where once I failed, you have succeeded. You have my deepest respect and gratitude, <name>. Perhaps you will best me in the arena as well.
